prompt.description: What the caller needs summarized, in its own words, including the paths it wants read. Required, and the only required field: the kernel-worker dispatches this stage with prose naming file paths, and a schema that does not declare `prompt` has it stripped as routing metadata before validation, leaving an empty payload that can never conform.

run_id.description: Session run id, passed verbatim. Required: the report may be written as an artifact under the run, and a subagent never sees SessionStart, so the delegation is its only source for the value.

output_path.description: Where to write the report, when the caller wants one on disk. Absent means the report travels back in `summary` alone.

examples.prompt: Analyze the reference kernel at work/flash.cu for /runs/20260914T120000Z-000000000000/artifacts/tpu-kernel-development/k01 (state file: /runs/20260914T120000Z-000000000000/artifacts/tpu-kernel-development/k01/state.json).
